Face to face with the protagonists of the ‘Klassiker’
Foul or no foul? Yellow card or not? You’re the referee at Germany’s biggest football match and have to make decisions in a matter of seconds. In this RefCam video, you’re right in the thick of the action and come up against stars such as Joshua Kimmich, Serhou Guirassy, Michael Olise and Nico Schlotterbeck. Which decision would you have made differently? Let us know in the comments!
